changelog: New voice command: say 'crossed checkbox' or 'cancelled checkbox' (or 'ক্রস দেওয়া চেকবক্স' / 'বাতিল করা চেকবক্স') alone while dictating and a new line with a crossed checkbox ☒ starts — mark checklist items cancelled or unavailable (out of stock, not needed, called off) instead of leaving them looking still to do. With Spoken Punctuation on, 'crossed checkbox' and 'crossed checkbox sign' also work mid-sentence. Undo removes just the box (78 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
